metadata.description: Claude Code plugins around savvy-flow: a session-capped variant, role-based agent costumes and a prompt prefill.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-flow: Fable (or any session model) orchestrates; workers run on cheaper models capped at the session model, always at medium effort.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress: progress bar and agents panel, with role-based animated costumes.

plugins.name: savvy-autostart
plugins.description: Pre-fills the prompt box with /savvy-flow:savvy-flow so the command runs on Enter.
